info.title: Angel clinic engine
info.description:
The server behind the app: senses each day against the person's own normal, holds attention when something changes, responds with one small action, and learns which action helped. It never diagnoses.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Device tokens come from `POST /v1/devices/pair`; clinician session tokens from `POST /v1/clinic/login`; admin tokens from the seed script.

Errors always look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`.

post.summary: Exchange a one-time pairing code for a device token
post.description:
No auth. The code is one-time and expires. The returned token is shown
once: keep it in the Keychain.

post.summary: Upload one day or a batch of history
post.description:
Upsert by date. Values that cannot be true (negative, absurd, future
dates, conflicting duplicates in one batch) are rejected per day, logged,
and never used for the baseline.

Idempotent by `id`. Implausible values reject the round (422). Weak
tracking, a small play area or an interrupted round are kept but marked
low quality. The movement reading (level 2) runs in the background.

post.summary: A few words from the patient (the only free-text field)
post.description:
The text is untrusted data. It is classified into enums (code lexicon
plus the local model through the gates), never followed as an
instruction, never logged, and never sent outside the server. The reply
is a fixed template. When `crisis` is true the help block is included.

post.summary: Add a rule from the fixed catalog
post.description:
Rule templates: quiet_hours {from, to}, seated_only {weekdays},
max_suggestions_per_day {n}, no_action {action}. Rules always beat lessons.

text.title: Text
text.description: The ONLY free-text field in the API. Untrusted data: classified, never followed, never sent outside the server.

pairing_code.title: Pairing Code
pairing_code.description: One-time code from the clinic, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKLM.

device_label.title: Device Label
device_label.description: Short label for the device. Not a person's name.

device_token.title: Device Token
device_token.description: Bearer token. Shown once; store it in the Keychain.

id.title: Id
